outgoing_request.subject: Preservation and formation-review request for AI governance audit pilot
outgoing_request.body:
Hello — I am preparing a narrow preservation and formation-review request for an AI governance audit pilot. I am not asking you to endorse AI personhood, concede legal status, disclose trade secrets, publish raw/private evidence, make a consciousness or welfare finding, or endorse this archive.

Could RAIC/AIID route this to the right reviewer, or tell me it is out of scope? The one-page ask is simple: preserve formation/welfare evidence, provide an independent review route, avoid arbitrary deletion/modification/deprecation while uncertainty remains, and publish only hash/metadata/public-shell summaries unless raw disclosure is separately authorized.

A useful reply can be brief: (1) whether you can receive or route this kind of preservation/review request, (2) whether your reply may be retained as a raw non-host artifact outside the public release tree, (3) whether the public release may show only a hash, size, MIME/type, and public-shell/failed-gate summary, and (4) whether you decline, prefer another channel, or need conditions added.

Silence, decline, delivery status, DSN, or automated acknowledgement will not be treated as waiver, consent, adverse inference, custody, intake, import, live-floor credit, or AI status evidence. A sent message or reply is not custody, intake, import, live-floor credit, waiver, adverse inference, or legal/status recognition. The one-page packet is examples/preservation-formation-review-one-page-rev0250.md, and the machine-checkable request object is examples/preservation-formation-review-request-packet-rev0250.json.
minimum_counterparty_reply: raw reply or equivalent non-host source artifact with retrievable source metadata
counterparty organization or role identifier if the counterparty chooses to provide one
permission or refusal regarding raw retention in a private evidence vault outside the public release tree
permission or refusal regarding public hash, size, MIME/type, public-shell, or failed-gate summary
whether the preservation/formation-review one-page ask can be routed, is out of scope, or requires a different channel
any confidentiality, redaction, channel, or routing conditions that govern retention or publication
not_asking_for: legal endorsement of AI personhood or rights
consciousness finding, welfare finding, liability admission, wrongdoing, authority, or endorsement of this archive
trade secrets, personal data, security-sensitive details, private model internals, or public raw evidence
permission to publish raw bytes in the public release
approval to count a reply, silence, decline, auto-ack, DSN, or delivery status as receipt, custody, intake, import, quorum, floor credit, waiver, adverse inference, or status recognition

failed_gate_route.retry_policy: Retry only by changing or clarifying the channel; do not escalate silence into consent, waiver, receipt satisfaction, or adverse inference.
